title: Verified packaged tool execution
summary: Load Python tool definitions from an already verified Official artifact, pin their source bytes, and invoke through a ToolHost whose methods recheck resolved API and edit authority.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: load_packaged_tools

artifact.description: Verified and signed-index-pinned LucArtifact supplied by bootstrap.

output.description: dict[str, PackagedTool], each carrying parameters, run/job/document, edits, package id, source path and digest.

operations.notes: No deadline or sandbox. Executes each source file once per load; retry re-executes it. Missing .py, >256 KiB, bad TOOLS, reserved tool names, invalid schemas or edit declarations refuse.

operations.name: compile_package
operations.notes: No deadline. Requires packaged-agent-tool surface, matching product when named, and exact code path/hash from the verified tool. Input is the tool parameters; output is object.

operations.name: validate_authority
operations.notes: No deadline. Requires project.read and exactly covered native edits/write API; additional package API/permission reach refuses via ValueError, mapped by Host to E_LUC_ADAPTER_AUTHORITY.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: ToolResult; a returned Mapping is wrapped as ToolResult.model.

operations.notes: No generic deadline/retry protection. Domain refusals and governed writes belong to the packaged tool interface. This operation's domain error set is intentionally incomplete until those tools are enumerated; output validation can raise jsonschema.ValidationError.

operations.name: validate_result
operations.notes: No deadline; validates with Draft202012Validator without the interaction 64 KiB result bound; invalid output raises ValidationError.

invariants.text: A layer replacing a packaged tool's Python file fails its original code pin.
Tool code receives ToolHost and every privileged call is reauthorized, with domain operations staying on governed Worker paths.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Trusted package code executes with Python exec inside the Runtime, not in a code sandbox. A cryptographic pin does not restrict what that trusted Python code can do.
